title: Uniform C^∞ approximation of a continuous compactly supported unit-bounded covector field, keeping the unit bound
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let g : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n be continuous with compact support and covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1 for every x, and let δ > 0. Then there is a C^∞ map h : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n with covectorEuclideanNorm (h x) ≤ 1 and covectorEuclideanNorm (h x − g x) ≤ δ for every x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ h : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) h ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (h x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (h x - g x) ≤ δ
